items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: We contacted Mr. Scarpelli, and we got an agreement to come out there

ctx.x: We stayed at the Furnace Club up through May, and part of June. And we came out and we laid off almost a couple of weeks. And in the meantime there was a bandleader named Claude Hopkins who had been to St. Louis, Missouri, and was asked about a band -- did he know of a band that he could send out there to work at a prominent nightclub in St. Louis, Missouri. Claude Hopkins askd us to contact the owners of a nightclub in St. Louis, Missouri, whose name was Anthony Scarpelli.

We contacted Mr. Scarpelli, and we got an agreement to come out there -- to come out to St. Louis, to go out to St. Louis, for four weeks. And this we moved the band from Cleveland to St. Louis, Missouri. We arrive in St. Louis, Missouri, on or about the 4th of July and the owners of the Plantation Club had a summer place -- that was a few miles out of town on Manchester Boulevard, in St. Louis.
